title: Yogurt, nonfat milk, flavors other than fruit

content.title: About
content.content: Yogurt made from nonfat milk without fruit flavorings is a fermented dairy product created by culturing skimmed milk with live Lactobacillus bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophilus. Flavors may include plain, vanilla, chocolate, caramel, etc.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nonfat yogurt retains most of the milk protein while containing virtually no fat.
The absence of fruit flavorings makes the product more neutral, ideal for cooking and baking.
Yogurt provides live probiotic cultures that support gut health.
In many markets it is sold in 150‑ml to 500‑ml containers.
Lactose content is lower than in whole milk but not completely eliminated.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Nonfat yogurt supplies about 5 g of protein per 100 g, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Virtually no fat makes it suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: It is a good source of calcium for bone health and is often fortified with vitamin D.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Live cultures aid digestion and support the immune system.

items.title: Low added sugar (when fruit flavors are omitted)
items.content: Without fruit flavorings, the product usually contains less added sugar.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Although lactose is reduced, people with intolerance should still be cautious.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergic reactions to casein or whey can occur in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Added additives
items.content: Some brands include stabilizers or sweeteners; check labels if you have sensitivities.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy it plain, blend into smoothies, use as a base for sauces, in casseroles, or as a low‑calorie substitute for sour cream and mayonnaise.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may become grainy.
